evidence_items.explanation: The survey establishes a pre-existing body of AI-related legislation. It neither counts all laws in force nor determines whether laws without AI keywords anticipated AI's effects, so it cannot establish the claimed proportions.

unresolved_gaps: No representative denominator for all laws in force was established.
The legislative survey measures AI mentions and enactments, not substantive anticipation across the existing legal corpus.
The evidence does not establish the drafting-date distribution against an agreed AI-emergence cutoff.
Examples of AI-specific rules do not determine whether they constitute 'very few' of all laws.
